blockers.finding: Exact frozen Dillon identity EA 20917 at 0.2; archived ACTIVE_FULL contradicts official gamebook and both club inactive lists. Official Bucs report lists Phillips as the injury inactive; Dillon had full practice each day and no final injury designation. No established loss due to injury. The evaluator requires retention of every archived case and disallows coverage exclusion for an archived identity; it has no appropriate archived healthy-scratch route.
blockers.nextAction: Use an explicitly authorized evaluator method that retains the old case, requires official non-injury inactive evidence, closes injury loss at zero, and never labels Dillon as an active participant or roster exit.

blockers.finding: Official final inactive records classify the unavailable Carolina players and identify Phillips as the injury inactive. Sanders was inactive without a game injury designation; frozen healthy value is zero, but the archived status should be retained and corrected accurately.
blockers.nextAction: Include Sanders in the same source-confirmed archive-preserving non-injury status review; do not label him active or silently conflate a healthy scratch with an injury absence.
